messages:
maria (eng-runtime): quick mid-window huddle — planned change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. runtime -> v2.15 (abc123), router will get a canary rule, api will pin MODEL_TAG=stable-2026-03-20, console is feature-flag gated. canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m. rollback triggers: error rate >=5% for 5m OR kv_eviction > 3x baseline for 3m. watch p50/p95 token latency and request success rate.

jon (eng-api): console migration order? do we need a DB migration for the model metadata?

tess (eng-console): no DB migration. console reads new metadata only when header X-MODEL-VERSION present — feature-flag gated so safe to enable after API pin. I'll prep the UI note for release notes.

akeem (eng-router): router note: v1.2 changed path normalization; I'll push a temporary canary rule 'canary-2026-03-20' to route /api/v1/generate to runtime-new. router can hold compatibility for 45m. Also we have to ignore x-kv-cache-hint from client for 10m as a safety hedge.

maria (eng-runtime): sequence preference? I vote runtime -> router -> api -> console. runtime first so new nodes are healthy before router starts sending them traffic. deploy-bot, what's your sequence?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job 7890. Proposed sequence: runtime:v2.15 -> router:canary-rule -> api:pin-model -> console:featureflag-on. ETA ~20m between major steps. use `/deploy confirm 7890` to start.

jon (eng-api): note: pin model in API container with env `MODEL_TAG=stable-2026-03-20` in the k8s template. Also prepare rollback snippet: set `MODEL_TAG=stable-2026-02-14` and re-deploy, then flip router back to route all to runtime-old.

sre-oncall: monitoring hooks deployed: https://dash/ri/deploys/3270012345 — alerts: runtime_error_rate_high, kv_eviction_spike, router_handshake_fail. Pager if p95 token latency > 500ms sustained 10m.

maria (eng-runtime): release notes draft: short bullets + link to changelog, mention no breaking API changes, the visible model version in console. I'll ping Mike if Dedicated needs heads-up.

tess (eng-console): release note line: "Model version visible in request inspector; feature gated, opt-in for now." Adding to the changelog.

akeem (eng-router): small caveat: older runtime may not respond to header `x-kv-cache-hint`. Will add compatibility toggle in router to ignore header for 10m window.

maria (eng-runtime): ok starting in 5. `/deploy confirm 7890`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting job 7890 step 1/4 runtime:v2.15 -> canary 5% (group canary-runtime-a)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: step complete — canary nodes healthy for 5m (health checks ok)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramping canary to 25% in 10m

jon (eng-api): seeing p50 +40ms on canary, p95 unchanged. no errors yet. keep an eye on kv_eviction.

sre-oncall: kv_eviction spiked 2.1x at t+12m, under rollback threshold. marking Level 2.

maria (eng-runtime): hold further ramps for 5m while we investigate eviction burst. rollback if spike >3x for 3m.

akeem (eng-router): found missing TTL override in new runtime config that caused short-lived evictions. pushing hotfix to canary group to restore TTL default.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix 7890-ht1 applied to canary-runtime-a, health check passing.

jon (eng-api): p50 back to +10ms baseline. p95 fine. proceed with staged ramp to 100% when ready.

tess (eng-console): console flag tested in staging, ready to flip after API pin step. will coordinate the flip-on webhook.

maria (eng-runtime): final checklist before router canary shift: release notes posted, dedicated team informed (via DM), rollback commands pinned in runbook, monitors green. proceeding to router canary shift in 2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router canary rule applied: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 20m. tracking at https://dash/ri/deploys/3270012345/route

akeem (eng-router): router ramping done, handshake health 100% across canary nodes. compatibility toggle engaged for header ignore.

jon (eng-api): API pinned to MODEL_TAG=stable-2026-03-20 and rolled via blue/green. smoke tests passing.

tess (eng-console): flipping feature flag in prod now. request inspector shows model version correctly.

sre-oncall: post-deploy check: p50/p95 within expected bounds, no sustained kv_eviction > 1.5x. closing monitoring window to informational.

maria (eng-runtime): nice work — closing this window. notes: runbook link: https://runbook/ri/release-3270012345, rollback commands saved, release notes published. thanks all :tada:

jon (eng-api): glhf

tess (eng-console): :shipit:

akeem (eng-router): good job team

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: job 7890 complete — all steps succeeded.
